change_observations.new_total_definition: new lateral plus tip elongation; classified segments only
change_observations.interpretation: Image-coordinate candidates only. Displacement, occlusion, missed segmentation or appearance changes can create these signals; they do not prove birth or death.
change_observations.death_status: not evaluated; missing roots are not labelled dead

periods.uncertainty_rule: max conditional probability <0.55 or top-two margin <0.15; additionally abstain when persistent pixels >12px from previous support, new pixels <=2px from old support, or an elongating component has no previous tip within 24px. All thresholds are exploratory native-pixel display rules, not validated anatomical decisions; reported metrics use raw unfiltered predictions.
